name: Mama Shelter Belgrade
desc: Mama Shelter Belgrade vous accueille au coeur de la ville, sur la rue piétonne Knez Mihailova. Ses 125 chambres modernes et confortables, son rooftop, ses 2 bars animés et son restaurant créent un cadre convivial, festif et coloré. Design audacieux, ambiance fun et services pensés pour tous font de chaque séjour une expérience unique, chaleureuse et pleine de vie.

name: Mercure Belgrade Excelsior
desc: Stay in the heart of Belgrade, minutes away from Republic Square, Knez Mihailova Street, and Kalemegdan Fortress, at our hotel inspired by Serbian culture. Situated in a historic building celebrating its 101th anniversary, the hotel offers a blend of historical charm and modern comfort, featuring pet-friendly, non-smoking, and family-friendly rooms, a cozy on-site restaurant, and a meeting room.

name: Mövenpick Resort and Spa Fruske Terme
desc: Looking for a beautiful hotel in Serbia? The Movenpick Fruske Terme Resort and Spa is a picturesque mountain spa resort, located in the oldest Serbian National Park, Fruska Gora. This stylish hotel is also within easy reach of Belgrade and Novi Sad. Arrive at nearby Nikola Tesla Belgrade and enjoy a relaxing stay in Serbia, whether you're visiting for business or pleasure.
